messages:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered for service=inference-gateway, alert=error_rate_high (threshold 5m>3%) — PagerDuty incident INC-2025-0812 fired
pd-bot: Incident INC-2025-0812 created, urgency=high, assigned=oncall-sre
olivia_sre: on it. seeing a big error_rate spike from us-west1, 502/503 starts ~09:07 UTC.
jamal_oncall: pinging infra-automation for autoscale checks, I'm looking at routing.
olivia_sre: graphs: cpu fine, p95 latency normal for healthy requests, error spread across many hosts not just one.
maya_prodeng: any customer-facing errors? do we have SLO error burn?
olivia_sre: yes some production customers reporting 502s. SLO breach risk depending on duration. dashboard: https://dash.redwood/inference/errors?region=usw1
infra-automation: autoscaler shows surge to 95% in queueing metric; new nodes provisioning but delayed ~90s due to cloud quota check.
jamal_oncall: sounds like a throughput stall; can we route traffic to secondary region?
olivia_sre: routing policy currently in quiet-window (PD maintenance) — auto-fallback suppressed. I'm going to override and enable fallback to us-east1. @jamal_oncall do you want me to toggle?
jamal_oncall: yes please. execute fallback now.
leo_solutions: heads up to solutions: customer-impact could be partial for us-west1 traffic; non-blocking for others.
olivia_sre: executing route override: ``/api/v1/routing/override --src=us-west1 --dest=us-east1 --reason="auto-fallback suppressed during quiet-window; emergency override"``
pagerbot: Route override applied by olivia_sre. Traffic shift started (approx 35% -> us-east1 in 20s).
olivia_sre: error rate dipping slightly post-shift, still elevated on remaining us-west1 slice.
pd-bot: INC-2025-0812 acknowledged by jamal_oncall at 09:12 UTC
jamal_oncall: checking KV cache evictions logs — I see high miss rate and spike in backend 429s from sidecar. Might be a backend connection exhaustion.
maya_prodeng: any sign of a deploy around 09:05?
olivia_sre: nope, last prod deploy 08:30. No recent canary.
infra-automation: running quick health check: ``kubectl get pods -n inference -l role=gateway -o wide`` -> several pods in Ready 1/2 (liveness flapping).
jamal_oncall: I'm scaling gateway pool from 20 -> 40 replicas to relieve queueing.
olivia_sre: issuing manual restart to 3 suspect sidecars to clear fd leaks: ``kubectl rollout restart deploy/gateway-sidecar -n inference --field-selector metadata.name in (gw-sidecar-7f8, gw-sidecar-9b2, gw-sidecar-3c1)``
pagerbot: Note: manual restarts may cause transient 503s. Proceeding.
leo_solutions: calling out to major customer POC list, prepping a brief.
olivia_sre: after restarts and route shift errors dropping 60% in 4m. still seeing small fanout of 502s when requests hit cold KV entries.
jamal_oncall: enabling cookie-affinity off for gw pool to increase cache hit diversity (short-term).
olivia_sre: applied flag: ``feature.cookie_affinity=false`` at 09:18 UTC
infra-automation: autoscaler now provisioning extra GPUs for dedicated inference pools as fallback; estimated ready ~2m.
maya_prodeng: can we enable degraded-mode for low-priority requests to reduce load?
jamal_oncall: yes setting weight=0.3 for non-prod customers via feature-gate.
olivia_sre: executing degraded-mode toggle: ``/api/flags/set degraded_mode=true scope=non-prod``
pagerbot: Pager update: INC-2025-0812 — mitigations in progress: route override, pod restarts, scaling, degraded-mode.
jamal_oncall: PD escalations scheduled if unacked > 10min but we've acked. next: confirm whether root cause is client retries or server-side KV eviction cascade.
olivia_sre: collecting flamegraphs & cpu profiles; initial look shows high syscalls around accept4 + epoll_wait. Might be kernel-level file descriptor exhaustion.
infra-automation: bumping ulimit for gateway nodes via systemd drop-in (rolling) — patch applied to node pool; one node already rejoined with higher fd limits.
leo_solutions: customer comms drafted: "We're aware of an elevated 502 rate in us-west1; traffic shifting/mitigations applied. We'll update in 30m."
maya_prodeng: schedule: if error rate <1% for 10m, start rollback of overrides; else we escalate to incident review.
olivia_sre: error rate steadying at ~0.8% (down from 4.3%). good sign. continuing to monitor.
pagerbot: Reminder: quiet-window suppression was active; consider adjusting suppression rules for critical gateway alerts.
jamal_oncall: agreed — will follow up with oncall-policy team to add exception for cross-region error surges.
olivia_sre: marking action items: 1) postmortem owner jamal_oncall, 2) follow-up on ulimit change to be part of node image, 3) review PD quiet-window config.
leo_solutions: filing a customer impact note in INC-2025-0812: "Partial 502s for ~20m affecting some US customers; temporary route shift to us-east1 reduced impact."
olivia_sre: closing loop — error rate <0.3% across all regions at 09:44 UTC, rolling back cookie-affinity and degraded-mode in stages.
pd-bot: INC-2025-0812 resolved by jamal_oncall at 09:45 UTC
jamal_oncall: leaving final notes here: root cause probable fd exhaustion + KV cold misses compounded by autoscaler lag during quota check. mitigation: node ulimit fix, route override runbook updated, PD quiet-window exception added.
maya_prodeng: thanks team. I'll schedule a post-incident review for tomorrow 16:00 UTC.
olivia_sre: thanks — adding links to logs & traces in the postmortem doc. :white_check_mark:
